title.narrative: Unlocking pathways to support implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan

description.narrative:
The project's objective of unlocking pathways to support the implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan directly contributes to several of these SDGs, such as SDG 7 (affordable and clean energy) and SDG 13 (climate action). The project aims to strengthen sustainability, integrate economic policies with environmental agendas, and enhance capacity building and research efforts in Pakistan, all of which are aligned with the SDGs prioritized by Denmark's development cooperation strategy. Therefore, the project's objectives are relevant in a global and national context and compatible with the strategic focus of SDGs prioritized in Denmark's current strategy for development cooperation and humanitarian action 'The World 2030'.
The project seeks to implement carbon markets in Pakistan by leveraging lessons from Denmark’s successful green initiatives and its expertise. It aimed to integrate sustainability into economic policies, align with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), enhance capacity building efforts, research, advocacy and foster stronger bilateral relation.

To enhance the Denmark-Pakistan relationship by fostering mutual benefits and bilateral cooperation. The goal is to learn from Denmark's best practices in green development and carbon markets, with a view to strengthening sustainability in Pakistan by harnessing local potential.
- The current knowledge gap in implementation framework of carbon is reduced by conducting a research Study on “Unlocking pathways to support implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan.
- The discourse of carbon markets is expedited at both federal and provincial level by conducting capacity building and training of all relevant stakeholders across the carbon value chain of Pakistan.
- The discourse on “Implementation of carbon markets in Pakistan” to foster climate action is increased through advocacy and communications outreach activities such a social, print, and electronic media campaign, documentaries and awareness raising campaigns.
